A read, not a dashboard

A trend spotted in an annual survey is already known to everyone. We follow topics month after month, tell what is really rising from what is just noise, and tell you what to build, what to watch and what to stop.

58:39 In their own words “Every trend now starts on TikTok.” Orange B. Hoang

Frequently asked questions

How early can a trend be spotted?

Often several months before it shows up in conventional surveys: niche communities talk about it long before the wider public.

Can you analyse our competitors' products?

Yes. Reviews, forums and networks talk as much about their products as yours: we compare strengths and irritants, product by product.

How is this different from market research?

A survey asks people what they think. We read what they say and do spontaneously, continuously, across a whole market.
